name: lightdash-content-admin
description: Lightdash Content Administration plugin for managing spaces, charts, and dashboards within a project.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Lightdash spaces, charts, and dashboards with lineage analysis and validation.
interface.longDescription: The Lightdash Content Administration plugin provides skills for organizing spaces, validating content, analyzing data lineage, and managing charts and dashboards within a Lightdash project. Supports both read and write operations with safety mode enforcement.
